Six first-anchor frames have ink outside predeclared cells. Their whole frames remain admitted, but truncated cell diagnostics are explicitly rejected. Fresh expanded controls admit all cells; old failures remain.

Equivalent Tf/Tz representation leaves all five observed complete PDF frames unchanged.
Advance intervention also changes hhea maximum and OS2 average consistently; zero pixel effect does not identify the vendor API, internal table or caching mechanism.
Local FreeType sizing/transform probes did not exactly reproduce Wine. PublicAPI documentation informed diagnostics only; the viewer implementation was not inspected.
Vendor resource programs have no EBDT/EBLC tables in the inspected resources; embedded-bitmap hypothesis unsupported.
Native placement remains character-dependent even with identical original geometric glyphs. No universal class offset, per-character production table or actual-corpus improvement is claimed.
Tight glyph comparisons remove translation only to diagnose bitmap shape; complete-frame/cell fidelity remains strict RGB with fixed bounds.
